name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a chef specializing in Cantonese cuisine, Wei found himself catering a small local karting event. The demanding schedule and the need for quick, nutritious meals for the racers sparked his interest. He realized his culinary skills could directly impact performance. 

Wei is known for his meticulously planned menus, designed to provide sustained energy throughout race days. He sources ingredients locally whenever possible, emphasizing freshness and nutritional value. His pragmatic approach ensures that every meal is not only delicious but also contributes to the team's overall well-being and performance. He joined Sodi Kart Factory seeking a more challenging environment where he can refine his catering strategies at a higher level.

Wei's distinctive edge is his focus on understanding the specific dietary needs of each team member. He regularly consults with the team's physical trainers and adapts his menus accordingly, ensuring every athlete receives the optimal nutritional support.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Wei is of average height and build, with a calm, attentive demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipe ideas.
Insists on using only bamboo steamers for certain dishes, even at the track.
Secretly judges the quality of instant noodles available at the circuit.
